I haven't emailed Thea. Her address is outside pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway has to approve it first, even as a draft. I logged the approval request and replied in the #north-team thread with a draft. Nothing goes out until Ruth says yes.

The draft, based on #inc-qfl-sev1:
1. The Superior dock-schedule sync broke at about 6:40 AM Quarrendon time on 4 Nov. Samir traced it to a deadlocked webhook listener, and a partial sync came back around 8:15 AM.
2. Samir's hotfix was deployed at 2:38 PM, after which his replay script finished and Superior syncs cleanly in real time again.

Check the times before it goes out. The channel doesn't give a time zone for the 2:38 PM hotfix. Your "6:40 AM" is in Quarrendon's time, while the channel timestamps are probably Pemberline's.
